notes:
A Fellowship quest, and the interesting decision is bullet 1's table: Luto sends you to ONE of three sites (Ordelle's Caves, Korroloka Tunnel, Ranguemont Pass) and the page cannot say which, because she picks. That is an OR over zones, not a set to visit, so it is NOT a group -- a group draws all its members and would claim you must do all three. Instead the site is one step with zone null, which matches wherever the ??? and the slime actually are, and all three candidates with their grids live in the note. Nothing is lost by the null: the target is a ???, which can never carry a marker anyway, and Metallic Slime exists only at those three spots.

Bullet 2 is four actions, not one: touch the ??? to pop the slime, kill it, talk to your Fellow for the line about Vitrallum, then touch the ??? again to receive it. The Fellow step keeps its rung but has no target -- an Adventuring Fellow is displayed under the name its owner gave it, so no name on the page could ever match a live entity. Vitrallum is a KEY ITEM (res id 732), not an inventory item, despite the header filing it under Item Reqs; that is why the evidence is kind ki. Its single evidence point is the second ??? touch, where you actually receive it.

'Quest Reqs: Familiarity Level of 45' is a Fellowship stat with no packet behind it, so it gates nothing here. The sub-bullets on bullet 4 are Geomagnetic Fount / Nexus Cape travel advice.

notes:
Four bullets and only three of them are actions. Bullets 2 and 3 contradict each other and the page never resolves it: bullet 2 says trade the fork to Verctissa to be 'transported to the arena', bullet 3 says trade the same fork to the Water Protocrystal to 'enter the fighting arena'. You are given one fork and the page never says what happens to it after the Verctissa trade. Notes bullet 6 only says you may RE-OBTAIN the fork from the starting NPC and that she will then stop teleporting you to the Cloister -- which is as easily read as the fork being consumed as it is as the fork surviving. Because the walkthrough's own instruction for entering the arena is bullet 3, that is kept as the required rung and Verctissa's trade is marked optional (a shortcut the page's own Notes say you can lose and still finish). The whole quest is demoted to medium on account of that unresolved contradiction rather than asserting a mechanic the page does not state.

The walkthrough never names the Cloister zone: the Description says 'the protocrystal in the Den of Rancor' and Notes bullet 6 says only 'the Cloister'. Rather than write a zone the page does not, the protocrystal step carries zone null, which costs nothing -- there is exactly one Water Protocrystal in the game, so a null-zone row lands in the right place anyway. The battle arena is an instanced BCNM with no name at all, so that step is zone-less too.

'Summoner Level 20 or higher' is both gates: level 20 AND jobs SMN. 'Outlands' is not one of the nine fame regions, so region is null and only the raw survives. Everything else in the Notes section is a battle condition -- solo only, Carbuncle only, 15 minute limit, buffs survive the level cap -- and none of it is a step.

Moved out of the player-facing step notes (build vocabulary; see AUTHORING.md, 'Two notes, two audiences'):
  step 1: The fork is an inventory item (res id 1549), not a key item.

a transport shortcut, not a requirement: Notes bullet 6 says she stops teleporting you once you re-obtain the fork, and the fight is still doable on foot. Prepare before trading -- you arrive ready to fight.
the page never names the zone -- the Description says 'the protocrystal in the Den of Rancor' and the Notes call it 'the Cloister' -- so none is recorded rather than guessed
alone, in an unnamed instanced arena, 15 minute limit. Only Carbuncle may be summoned (the page says Siren also works but reads as unintended); buffs applied outside survive the level cap.

notes:
A clean five-rung Abyssea loop, but the page has a trap at the bottom: the '== Augments ==' section's contents are rendered as top-level bullets [7] to [11] ('Resist Paralyze+1~3', '+1~5', 'Attack+1~6'). They continue the walkthrough's numbering but they are the reward ring's augment table, not steps -- a verb-scanner would produce five nonsense rungs from them.

Bullet 2 is only the journey to the grass at (I-10), so it merges into bullet 3's interaction rather than becoming a travel rung to the zone you are already standing in. The Rockhopper is a targetable spot that only appears after you /clap in the right patch, so the marker for it can never be early; the key item of the same name (res id 1623) is the evidence.

The Phial of counteragent is carried to the Gasponia flowers -- the Description says the phial is the formula that stops the fumes -- so it is items on step 4, and evidence only where it is handed over. Jakaka (A) is the page's own 'Optional:', information only. Fame 'aatt' is an Abyssea area code, not one of the nine regions, so it gates nothing and only the raw survives.

notes:
A straight there-and-back ladder with one split: bullet 3 is two actions on the same ??? at (I-9) -- touch once for a cutscene, touch again to pop War Lynx -- and then bullet 4 sends you back to the same ??? a third time after the kill. Touch one and touch two are kept as a single rung because nothing observable separates them; the post-kill touch is its own rung because the fight sits between them, exactly as the page has it.

'Leave the fortress back to the main map' is a map change inside Fort Karugo-Narugo (S), not a zone change, so steps 2 to 5 all stay in that one zone. The sub-bullet on bullet 2 (Cavalry Gate at (F-8), or the Phosphorous Ward at (I-9) to drop the magic gate) is route advice for reaching the Fivespires map and is kept as a note rather than a rung -- it is an OR between two ways in, and neither is observable.

The page is in Category:Verification and its own War Lynx HP figure is tagged unverified; nothing that affects the ladder depends on it. The Notes section is a reminder to touch a Cavernous Maw for a later mission, not a step of this quest. No key item appears anywhere, so this quest has no evidence at all -- the ladder rests on the session latch.

notes:
Ten bullets, but bullet 4 is not a step at all -- it is the roster of the three Sahagin that bullet 3 spawned, so its names go onto the spawn and the fight and it never gets a rung of its own. Bullet 2 is only the walk to (I-7), where bullet 3's ??? already is, so the two merge; the Survival Guide and Unity Warp lines under it are travel advice.

Only ONE of Kappa Akuso, Kappa Biwa and Kappa Bonze has to die, which is why all three are recorded with count 1 and the note carries the constraint -- there is no count that means 'any one of these'. The ??? is touched twice, before and after, and the second touch is where the Old trick box arrives, so that is its evidence and the fight has none.

Three separate key/box items make this an unusually well-evidenced ladder: Old trick box at the ???, Kuftal Coffer Key in the tunnel, Large trick box from the coffer, each on exactly the step that grants it. The coffer key's two sources (drop in Kuftal Tunnel, or the Curio Vendor Moogle) both end in the same item, so items_partial stays false -- nothing is inexpressible, it is the same evidence either way. 'Level: 50+ Ninja' is both gates.

notes:
Five bullets that are really three rungs. Bullets 2, 3 and 4 are one continuous interaction with a single Martello -- find it, open its menu, choose 'Prepare to upgrade martello', confirm, then stand where the MENU says (the page warns the log gives a different, wrong direction). Splitting those into three would put two unmarkable rungs on the same object and gain nothing.

The key-item swap is the quest's only observable: the Fuel reservoir arrives at bullet 1 and is silently replaced by the Cracked fuel reservoir at the martello, which the page notes never reaches the log. Two key items, two steps, no overlap. Both resolve (res 1560 and 1562).

The unnumbered line above bullet 1 is a cooldown -- one Refuel and Replenish OR A Mightier Martello per Vana'dielian day across all of Abyssea -- and is not a step. Nor is the warning that zoning mid-quest destroys the key item, but it is worth keeping in the note because it is the one way to lose the ladder halfway. The page deliberately gives no martello grids, pointing at the Martello page and the Confluxes instead, so the middle step has a zone and no grid.

steps.note: near the zone entrance; choose 'Assist with upgrades'. Do not zone at any point after this -- it destroys the key item and you start over.

any martello in the zone, usually near a Conflux; the page lists no grids. notes:
Scholar AF, and two of its six bullets are pure zone-line triggers rather than places to click: bullet 2 fires on zoning into Southern San d'Oria (S) specifically from East Ronfaure (S) -- the page says Survival Guide and telecrystal do not count -- and bullet 4 the same for Sauromugue Champaign (S) from Rolanberry Fields (S). Those are travel steps targeting the destination zone, with the required approach in the note; there is no entity to point at, and inventing one would be worse than a zone marker.

Bullet 5 is the only rung with anything observable on it: the Indescript Markings targetable spot in the south-eastern corner of (J-7), which grants Ulbrecht's mortarboard (res 985). The page also warns it VANISHES in Dusty weather, which nothing in the packets reports, so the marker can point at empty ground -- flagged rather than hidden. There is a ??? beside it that is not part of this quest, so the target is the Markings by name and not the ???.

Bullet 1's sub-bullet is a game-day wait after On Sabbatical, not a step. The Notes section is a pointer to Loussaire in Bastok Markets (S) for the remaining AF pieces after this quest, and its transcluded content is unavailable here anyway -- nothing there belongs in this ladder.

notes:
Short and mostly correct, with one gate that has to be thrown away deliberately. 'Level: 40 or lower' is a CEILING, not a floor -- writing 40 into the level field would gate the quest to characters of level 40 and above, the exact opposite of what the page says -- so level stays null and the ceiling lives in a flag and this note. The party requirement (a second real player under 40; Trusts and Fellows do not count, Level Sync does) has no slot and nothing observable behind it either, so bullet 2 gets no rung at all: it is a precondition with no target, no zone and no evidence, and a rung for it would be pure noise.

The header names Hawk Nose as Datta's partner you are to 'meet with', but the walkthrough never has you speak to him -- the cutscene fires off a ??? near the Kuftal Tunnel entrance -- so he is not a step. The page gives no grid for that ???, only 'near the entrance', which is where the Survival Guide sits.

The Notes section is trivia: the cutscene showing your party members is rare, and you can replay it from the Goblin Footprint afterwards. Neither is a step, and the Goblin Footprint replay is post-quest.

steps.note: on the cliff just inside the entrance; the page gives no grid. You need a party of at least two players of level 40 or lower first -- Trusts and Adventuring Fellows do not count, Level Sync does. The Survival Guide is right at the entrance; otherwise a Rabao chocobo crosses the desert without aggro. Only non-aggressive Sand Lizards are nearby.
8,000 gil; the cutscene can be watched again afterwards from the Goblin Footprint
